baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction خَلَقَ ... مِن صَلْصَالٍ كَالْفَخَّارِ joins making, source material, and a pottery comparison.
baseline_models.mechanism: The measuring and completed-form branches of خ ل ق combine with dry ringing clay and pottery: the human is deliberately proportioned into a rigid, audible form, not merely sourced from generic earth.

activation_trace.role: Measuring and proportioning supplies the deliberate formative operation.
Complete balanced form supplies the achieved bodily shape.
Dry clay that rings and can become pottery supplies both material stage and acoustic test.
Pottery and fired clay supplies the explicit comparison and vessel-form endpoint.

changed_reading.before: God created the human from clay resembling pottery.
changed_reading.after: God proportioned the human into a completed, dry-resonant material form poised at the threshold of pottery.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ٱلْإِنسَانَ is named inside a verse whose source material is characterized by ringing resonance.
baseline_models.mechanism: The human root presents an outwardly available presence and the act of sensing or hearing it; the clay root presents repeated sound in a hard dry thing. Humanity is therefore readable as embodied presence that becomes perceptible by sounding.

activation_trace.role: Visible human presence supplies the creature's outwardly manifest mode.
Perception by seeing, sensing, or hearing makes that presence detectable.
Ringing recurrence in a dry hard object gives embodied presence an audible signature.

changed_reading.before: The verse identifies what the human was made from.
changed_reading.after: The verse also characterizes the human as a manifest body whose hard material constitution can announce and disclose presence through sound.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus roots themselves contain a water-holding hollow, a sounding water remnant, and a pottery jar.
baseline_models.mechanism: A dry exterior and mobile residue coexist: the made human can be carried as a hollow earthen vessel whose interior holds a remainder that sounds when moved. This does not replace the overt dry-clay sense; it exposes an interior/exterior model latent within the same focus words.

activation_trace.role: A hollow or new well that retains water supplies the body's containing cavity.
A remnant of water sounding in motion supplies a mobile interior remainder.
The pottery jar supplies the bounded earthen exterior that can hold the remainder.

changed_reading.before: The human is a homogeneous piece of dried clay.
changed_reading.after: The human may also be imagined as a dry earthen enclosure carrying a residual, mobile interior whose movement makes the enclosure speak.

context_deltas.mechanism: Celestial counting, installed weight, straight measure, and focus-root proportioning form one calibration sequence. Human clay is a measured embodiment within the same ordered economy as orbit, balance, and apportioned earth.

activation_trace.role: Proportioning supplies the focus-level operation to be strengthened.
Counting and calculation supplies the macrocosmic regime of exact recurrence.
A created thing formed in equilibrium directly links creation with balanced embodiment.
Measure and fixed quantity turns balance into concrete apportionment.

structural_cues: 55:5-10 moves from celestial calculation through the installed balance to the placed earth before 55:14 returns to human making.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies counting, weight, quantity, and focus-root proportion; I infer that one calibrating logic governs the clay body. A live alternative is that the earlier measures are only adjacent cosmic and legal norms.

changed_reading.before: Creation from clay chiefly describes origin material.
changed_reading.after: Creation from clay describes calibrated embodiment: the human is measured into form under the same balance that orders the surah's cosmos.

context_deltas.mechanism: Teaching and disclosure by speech or sign give the focus's ringing material a function. The human body is not merely sonorous; it is tuned material through which concealed meaning becomes perceptible expression.

activation_trace.role: Repeated resonance in hard matter supplies the body's acoustic capacity.
Perception by hearing or sensing supplies the receiving side of communication.
Knowledge becoming disclosed to a knower supplies intelligible content.
Revealing meaning through speech or sign turns resonance into articulation.

structural_cues: 55:3 creates the human, 55:4 teaches it البيان, and 55:14 later specifies that human's ringing material.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies acoustic material, teachability, and articulate disclosure; I infer a functional arrow from bodily resonance to meaningful speech. The live alternative is that the clay's sound only diagnoses dryness.

changed_reading.before: The pottery comparison concerns texture and hardness.
changed_reading.after: The pottery comparison also makes the human an articulate resonator: formed matter capable of receiving knowledge and sounding meaning.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent origin accounts oppose a visible, bounded, ringing human body to a concealed being of restless mingled flame. The contrast is not merely clay versus fire but manifest resonance versus hidden turbulence.

activation_trace.role: Visible human presence supplies the manifest pole of the pair.
Dry resonant clay supplies the human pole's bounded hard material.
The concealed jinn supplies the hidden pole set immediately beside the human.
Mixture and disturbance supplies the fire-being's unstable material behavior.
Kindled fire supplies the luminous combustible medium of the contrasting origin.

structural_cues: 55:14 and 55:15 are parallel creation clauses, followed by a dual refrain and later joint address to humans and jinn.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visible-versus-concealed root images and dry resonance versus disturbed fire; I infer an ontological contrast in modes of presence. A live alternative is that the roots only label two species and two source substances.

changed_reading.before: 55:14 independently reports the human material while 55:15 reports another creature's material.
changed_reading.after: 55:14 defines the human relationally as the visible, shape-retaining, resonant pole beside a hidden, turbulent fire-being.

context_deltas.mechanism: The water-holding and jar branches in the focus become an active boundary model under the two-seas sequence: opposed contents meet, a between-space connects while limiting transgression, and valuables emerge. Human form can thus be a productive interface rather than a sealed lump.

activation_trace.role: A water-holding hollow supplies the focus-level containing form.
The pottery jar supplies a bounded but usable earthen vessel.
A connection standing between endpoints makes the barrier relational rather than merely obstructive.
Two opposed things arriving together supplies contact across the interface.
Exceeding a limit by transgression supplies the boundary condition that is prevented.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies productive emergence from bounded contact.

structural_cues: 55:19-24 sequences meeting waters, a non-transgressed interval, emergent pearl and coral, and constructed vessels on the sea.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a pottery container and a bounded marine meeting that yields emergence; I infer that boundary is a productive function of formed humanity. The alternative is that the marine scene has no anthropological transfer.

changed_reading.before: The pottery-like human is a closed, static object.
changed_reading.after: The pottery-like human is a bounded interface: differentiated enough to hold limits, open enough for encounter, and capable of bringing hidden contents forth.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pottery's hard achieved form is reread against universal passing-away and divine remaining. The focus describes a temporarily stabilized body: audible because rigid, vulnerable because dry, and destined to lose the form it received.

activation_trace.role: Dry pottery supplies a stabilized but breakable material form.
Material worn smooth and threadbare keeps deterioration latent inside the creation root.
Cessation after a period of remaining supplies the formed creature's temporal limit.
Enduring continuation supplies the contrast against which created form is temporary.

structural_cues: 55:26-27 places the passing of everything upon earth directly against the remaining divine face.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dry pottery, a wear branch, perishing, and remaining; I supply the arrow from rigid dryness to brittleness. The alternative is a general mortality contrast with no special material implication.

changed_reading.before: Pottery imagery emphasizes completed hardness and stability.
changed_reading.after: Pottery imagery marks a finite stabilization: the human has received a definite form precisely as something that can wear, fracture, and pass away.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's repeated ringing is bracketed by an identical refrain whose non-dominant mapped inventory includes one sound following another. The creation statement can therefore function like a sounded vessel inside a recurring call, making the human an addressed resonator expected to answer.

activation_trace.role: Repeated ringing in a hard thing supplies the focus's echoing material behavior.
The non-dominant split branch of one sound following another supplies the refrain's preceding echo.
The same sound-following-sound branch supplies the answering echo after the paired creation accounts.

structural_cues: 55:14-15 is enclosed by identical dual-address refrains at 55:13 and 55:16, and that refrain recurs throughout the surah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ringing clay, a form-distant non-dominant mapped branch of sonic succession, and exact bracketing repetition; I infer a call-and-response function. A live alternative is that the split mapping is accidental and the repetition only rhetorical.

changed_reading.before: The verse is a statement about a created object placed between refrains.
changed_reading.after: The verse sounds the created human like a vessel inside a repeated address, shifting humanity from inert object to resonant respondent.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus inventory says its dry clay becomes pottery when fired; the immediately adjacent creation is from kindled fire, and later smokeless flame returns. This activates a process reading in which dry clay is not only compared to a finished product but stands at a heat-transformable threshold.

activation_trace.role: Dry resonant clay that becomes pottery when fired supplies the latent transformation.
Fired pottery supplies the transformed endpoint named by the simile.
Kindled fire supplies heat immediately beside the dry-clay origin account.
Flame without smoke keeps intense transformative heat active later in the context.

structural_cues: The clay/pottery verse and fire-origin verse are adjacent parallel clauses; fire imagery returns at 55:35.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a clay-to-pottery branch, adjacent fire, and later flame; I supply the kiln arrow. The materially live alternative is that fire only contrasts the jinn's separate origin and later judgment, never acting on human clay.

changed_reading.before: Like pottery is a static comparison to an already recognizable object.
changed_reading.after: Like pottery can also expose a process horizon: the human is dry, resonant clay whose form can be tempered, hardened, or tested by heat.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because فَخَّار in the construction plainly activates pottery, not an adjective meaning boastful; it remains valid as secondary root-play because the same focus inventory supplies boasting and pottery while صلصال supplies loud resonance. Render it only as an exploratory moral-acoustic overtone, never as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The final focus noun carries both pottery and boasting branches beside a root of ringing sound.

activation_trace.role: Pottery supplies the overt nominal sense and the hollow resonant object.
Boasting through inherited distinction supplies a latent social form of loud self-display.
Ringing recurrence supplies the acoustic bridge between vessel and boast.

changed_reading.before: Pottery is only a neutral comparison for dried clay.
changed_reading.after: As a contained overtone, the creature of ringing pottery already carries the possibility of becoming noisy with self-magnification: material resonance can turn into social boast.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is cross-domain and surprising because سنفرغ and الثقلان do not require literal emptying or weighing; it remains branch-backed and focus-anchored through the water-holding hollow and pottery vessel. Render it explicitly as an accountability metaphor activated by 55:31, with the ordinary idiomatic readings kept live.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's hollow and pottery branches permit later emptying-and-weight imagery to act on the human vessel.

activation_trace.role: A water-retaining hollow supplies the human as a container with contents.
The pottery jar gives that container a concrete earthen body.
Pouring out and emptying a vessel supplies exposure of what the formed container held.
Weight and measure supplies evaluation of the two addressed beings after exposure.

changed_reading.before: The clay vessel image concerns constitution alone.
changed_reading.after: The human may be carried as an accountable vessel whose hidden contents can be poured forth and whose resulting weight can be assessed.

strongest_changes: The clay-origin statement became a calibrated formation account governed by the surah's counting and balance.
Ringing material became functional: a visible human body receives knowledge, articulates meaning, and can answer repeated address.
The adjacent jinn account revised clay versus fire into manifest bounded resonance versus concealed turbulence.
Marine boundaries, universal finitude, and adjacent heat kept vessel, interface, brittle-form, and tempering readings simultaneously live.
summary.what_was_special: The four focus roots activated material, acoustic, social, hydraulic, moral, and temporal mechanisms without collapsing into one interpretation. Context sharpened a human-as-form, resonator, boundary, vessel, fragile body, and addressed respondent, while the pottery/boasting double remained a contained but live surprise.
remaining_uncertainties: The kiln arrow may be only an adjacency effect; the fire can remain a contrasting origin rather than a transformer of clay.
The ء ل و to ت ل و sound-succession activation is intentionally retained but may be a split-mapping artifact rather than operative wordplay.
The residual-water and emptied-weighted-vessel readings rely on branch-level cross-domain transfer and should remain exploratory.
The boasting overtone is root-anchored but should never displace the overt pottery noun.
